Cost model: 4-8 us per point-level-step, 80% parallel efficiency on one 64-core node. Output is uncompressed netCDF; netCDF-4 deflate typically halves it.

On the project HPC node and the in-house 100 TB storage the marginal cost is zero; the cloud columns are the price of keeping the same bytes in Google Cloud Storage (us-central1 list price; egress to the internet is billed separately).
